response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_own FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), o AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(g.avg_own) AS mean_avg_ownership, AVG(g.avg_own - o.overall) AS mean_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.avg_own > o.overall
